title: Finding
description: Canonical shape for a single security finding, emitted by any security-skill detector. See plans/001-finding-schema-output.md and meetings/2026-07-22-1056-plan-001-kickoff.md in the security-skill-workspace repo for design rationale.

findingId.description: Stable identifier for this finding, derived from ruleId + normalized location + repository (e.g. a hex-encoded hash). Used for dedup and suppression across scans of the same commit.

ruleId.description: Dot-namespaced identifier for the detection rule that fired, e.g. 'secret.aws-access-key' or 'code-review.sqli.string-concat'.

subSkill.description: Which sub-skill produced this finding. 'auth' added in schemaVersion 1.1.0 (plan 023 kickoff, 2026-07-22) — Broken AuthN/AuthZ split off from 'code-review' into its own plan-tracked sub-skill rather than reusing that value, since CONTEXT.md's split decision treats it as distinct enough to want independent policy/reporting grouping. 'cicd-pipeline' added in schemaVersion 1.2.0 (plan 013 implementation, 2026-07-22) — CI/CD Pipeline Skill, per that plan's own kickoff note reserved here in advance.

artifactType.description: The kind of artifact this finding was found in, per CONTEXT.md §4 (Scope).

title.description: Short human-readable summary of the finding.

problem.description: What was found and why it's a problem.

impact.description: The consequence if this finding is left unaddressed / exploited.

recommendation.description: How to fix or mitigate the finding.

references.description: One or more standards citations this finding maps to (CWE, OWASP, NIST SSDF, etc.). A finding may legitimately map to more than one.

confidence.description: Detector's self-reported estimate (0-100) of true-positive likelihood at detection time. Not globally calibrated in v1 (see plans/004-decision-layer-scoring.md).

detectorSource.description: Which detector/rule-pack (and version) produced this finding, for reproducibility and false-positive triage.

suppressed.description: Whether this finding has been suppressed by an org exception. Suppressed findings remain visible in output (audit trail) but do not trigger policy action. Suppression logic itself lives in plans/004-decision-layer-scoring.md.

suppressionReason.description: Required in practice when suppressed=true; free text explaining why.

metadata.description: Extensible, sub-skill-specific data. E.g. for CVE-based findings (plans/008-dependency-skill.md): raw CVSS vector string and score, used to derive `severity` via the standard band mapping documented in that plan, but preserved here for traceability.

severity.description: Risk classification per CONTEXT.md §8. As assessed by the detector at detection time; contextual adjustment is the Decision layer's job (plans/004-decision-layer-scoring.md), not this schema's.

id.description: The identifier within that standard, e.g. 'CWE-89', 'A03:2021'.

url.description: Optional link to the standard's canonical entry.

startByte.description: Byte offset of the finding's start within the file. Decided 2026-07-22: byte-range addressing is built in from v1 (not deferred) so plans/015-action-layer-recommendations-autofix.md can target fixes precisely. Detectors should populate this whenever their parser can provide it.

endByte.description: Byte offset of the finding's end within the file.

astNodePath.description: Optional AST-node path/selector (detector-specific format) for detectors backed by a real AST parser. Not all artifact types have a meaningful AST (e.g. plain-text config) — omit rather than fake it.
